faqs.q: How much do permanent outdoor lights cost?
faqs.a: Starter installs from $950 (single-facade, ~30 ft, one zone). Most single-story homes range $2,800-$5,800. Two-story: $5,800-$9,000. Estate and commercial: $7,500+.

faqs.q: Are permanent outdoor lights worth it?
faqs.a: Over 10 years, yes — significantly. A standard install at $2,800 vs. typical Fresno-area annual Christmas-light services at $800-$1,800/year ($8,000-$18,000 over 10 years). Permanent lights also cover 200+ holidays beyond Christmas.

faqs.q: Are permanent outdoor lights visible during the day?
faqs.a: No. The aluminum track is color-matched to your trim (white, bronze, black, brown) and tucks tightly under the eave. From the curb at noon, you'd never know they're there.
Lifetime warranty on aluminum track. 5-year on LEDs and workmanship. Plus 7-day refund guarantee.
